definitions.gloss: to drive into, to chase into
definitions.explanation: To force someone or something into a confined space by chasing.

definitions.gloss: to corner, to push into a difficult situation
definitions.explanation: To force someone into a desperate or disadvantageous position, either literally or figuratively.

examples.japanese: ⟦{羊|ひつじ}→羊：04713_hitsuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}い→囲い：12039_kakoi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{込|こ}む。
examples.english: To drive the sheep into the pen.
The cat chased the mouse into a corner of the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{袋小路|ふくろこうじ}→袋小路：09385_fukurokouji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The criminal was cornered in a dead end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{追|お}い{込|こ}まれた⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: He's in a desperate situation due to debt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追|お}い{込|こ}んで⟦トレーニング→トレーニング：00408_toreeningu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To push oneself hard during training.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB: ⟦{追|お}う→追う：02016_ou⟧ (to chase) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (to go into) = to chase into

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive. Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark what is being driven/cornered.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦{窮地|きゅうち}→窮地：08684_kyuuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{込|こ}む (to drive into a tight spot)
・{追|お}い{込|こ}まれる (to be cornered - passive form)
・⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追|お}い{込|こ}む (to push oneself)
・⟦{崖|がけ}っぷち→崖っぷち：16343_gakeppuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{込|こ}む (to push to the brink)

USAGE NOTE: Often used in the passive form {追|お}い{込|こ}まれる when describing being put in a difficult situation.

・⟦{誘|さそ}い{込|こ}む→誘い込む：06211_sasoikomu⟧ - to lure into
・⟦{駆|か}け{込|こ}む→駆け込む：06112_kakekomu⟧ - to rush into
